description: Stations de tramways et BHNS du SDIT - MEL - 2022 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mel-geoserver.lillemetropole.fr. Données des stations de tramways et BHNS (Bus à Haut Niveau de Service) issues du bilan de concertation du SDIT (Schéma Directeur d'Infrastructures de Transport). Le positionnement des stations reste indicatif à ce jour et leurs positions sont susceptibles de changer. Autre donnée associée: Lignes BHNS et tramways du SDIT - MEL - 2022. Coverage: the Métropole Européenne de Lille. Its keywords include transports, bhns, mobilités, sdit, métropole européenne de lille, stations de tramway. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
